title: Noninvasive discrimination of benign and malignant breast lesions using genome-wide nucleosome profiles of plasma cell-free DNA.
authors: Han, Bo-Wei; Cai, Geng-Xi; Liu, Qing; Yang, Xu; Guo, Zhi-Wei; Huang, Li-Min; Li, Kun; Ouyang, Guo-Jun; Yang, Xue-Xi; Ye, Guo-Lin; Wu, Ying-Song
journal: Clinica chimica acta; international journal of clinical chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用血浆游离DNA核小体谱反映转录因子活性，结合机器学习区分乳腺良恶性病变，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点可及性分析，但核心是临床诊断应用，缺乏三维互作建模与机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Breast malignancy is the most frequently diagnosed malignancy in women worldwide, and the diagnosis relies on invasive examinations. However, most clinical breast changes in women are benign, and invasive diagnostic approaches cause unnecessary suffering for the patients. Thus, a novel noninvasive approach for discriminating malignant breast lesions from benign lesions is needed. METHODS: We performed cell-free DNA (cfDNA) sequencing on plasma samples from 173 malignant breast lesion patients, 158 benign breast lesion patients, and 102 healthy women. We then analyzed the cfDNA-based nucleosome profiles, which reflect the various tissues of origin and transcription factor activities. Moreover, by using machine learning classifiers along with the cfDNA sequencing data, we built classifiers for discriminating benign from malignant breast lesions. Receiver operating characteristic curve analyses were used to evaluate the performance of the classifiers. RESULTS: cfDNA-based nucleosome profiles reflected the various tissues of origin and transcription factor activities in benign and malignant breast lesions. The cfDNA-based transcription factor activities and breast malignancy-specific transcription factor-binding site accessibility profiles could accurately distinguish benign and malignant breast lesions, with area under the curve values of 0.777 and 0.824, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Our proof-of-principle study established a methodology for noninvasively discriminating benign from malignant breast lesions.
abstract_zh: 背景：乳腺癌是全球女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤，其诊断依赖于侵入性检查。然而，大多数女性临床上的乳房变化为良性，侵入性诊断方法给患者带来了不必要的痛苦。因此，需要一种新型非侵入性方法来区分恶性乳腺病变与良性病变。方法：我们对173名恶性乳腺病变患者、158名良性乳腺病变患者和102名健康女性的血浆样本进行了游离DNA（cfDNA）测序。随后，我们分析了基于cfDNA的核小体谱，这些谱反映了不同的组织来源和转录因子活性。此外，通过使用机器学习分类器结合cfDNA测序数据，我们构建了区分良性和恶性乳腺病变的分类器。采用受试者工作特征曲线分析评估分类器的性能。结果：基于cfDNA的核小体谱反映了良性和恶性乳腺病变中不同的组织来源和转录因子活性。基于cfDNA的转录因子活性和乳腺癌特异性转录因子结合位点可及性谱能够准确区分良性和恶性乳腺病变，其曲线下面积值分别为0.777和0.824。结论：我们的概念验证研究建立了一种非侵入性区分良性与恶性乳腺病变的方法。
